description: UI wiring for quarter selection: add a global quarter selector (prev / 'YYYY-Qn' label / next) to the Avaliação, Nine Box, and Plano view heads, hold selectedPeriod state in app.js (default = current quarter), and adapt renderEvaluate/setScore, renderPlan/persistPlan/addTask/toggleTask/removeTask + objective modal, and renderNineBox to read/write the selected period. The team-average radar overlay and Nine Box must use the SAME selected quarter. Collaborators can change the quarter to browse history but remain read-only (existing canEdit() gating). Depends on FEAT-001 (period helpers + period-aware Model). Leaves the Evolução tab for FEAT-003.
steps:
In index.html, add a quarter-selector container into the .view-head of #view-evaluate, #view-ninebox, and #view-plan. Prefer a single JS-rendered component: add an empty container element in each head, e.g.
(and q-sel-ninebox, q-sel-plan), placed so the existing .view-head right-align still works (the bar can sit before the existing .select; adjust as needed so controls don't overlap).

In js/app.js, add `let selectedPeriod = Store.currentPeriodKey();` near the other state vars (members/selectedId). Add helpers: `function shiftPeriod(key, delta){ const [y,q] = key.split('-Q').map(Number); let idx = (y*4 + (q-1)) + delta; const ny = Math.floor(idx/4); const nq = (idx%4)+1; return ny + '-Q' + nq; }` and `function renderQuarterBar(containerId){ ... }` that renders prev button, the selectedPeriod label, and next button into the given container; prev/next call `setSelectedPeriod(shiftPeriod(selectedPeriod, -1|+1))`.

Add `function setSelectedPeriod(key){ selectedPeriod = key; const v = $('.nav-item.active')?.dataset.view; if(v==='evaluate') renderEvaluate(); else if(v==='ninebox') renderNineBox(); else if(v==='plan') renderPlan(); else if(v==='evolution') { /* FEAT-003 */ } }`. Call renderQuarterBar for the matching container at the top of renderEvaluate, renderNineBox, and renderPlan.

Add a period accessor on member in app.js: `function memberPeriod(member, create){ if(!member.periods) member.periods = {}; if(!member.periods[selectedPeriod]){ if(!create) return { scores:{}, plan:[] }; member.periods[selectedPeriod] = { scores:{}, plan:[] }; } return member.periods[selectedPeriod]; }`.

Update renderEvaluate: pass selectedPeriod to Model.performanceScore/potentialScore/nineBoxLabel and (in buildPillarCard) to Model.pillarAverage; read current competency value from memberPeriod(member,false).scores[pillar.id]?.[comp.name]; in drawRadar pass selectedPeriod to Model.memberScoresByCompetency and Model.teamAverageByCompetency.

Update setScore to write into memberPeriod(member,true).scores (create the period on first write), toggling as today, then Store.save(member) and renderEvaluate(). After save, keep members array entry in sync (migrateOnRead mutates in place; ensure the local 'members' array reference is the same object).

Update the PDI functions to use the selected period's plan: in renderPlan read `const plan = memberPeriod(member,false).plan || []`; in persistPlan/addTask/toggleTask/removeTask and the objective-modal save/delete handlers, mutate memberPeriod(member,true).plan instead of member.plan. Keep uid(), progress, and task logic unchanged.

Update renderNineBox to compute points with Model.performanceScore(m, selectedPeriod)/Model.potentialScore(m, selectedPeriod) and labels with Model.nineBoxLabel(m, selectedPeriod); update renderNineBoxGuide counts to use Model.nineBoxLabel(m, selectedPeriod).

Update reloadAndRender: after re-reading members, re-render the active view so the quarter bar and period data stay in sync (it already calls renderEvaluate; also handle ninebox/plan as it does today).
Do not change canEdit() gating — collaborators keep read-only dots/checkboxes even when browsing other quarters.
acceptance_criteria: app.js loads with no console errors; the quarter bar renders in Avaliação, Nine Box, and Plano with working prev/next that change the YYYY-Qn label.
As leader in local mode: setting scores on the current quarter, switching to a different (empty) quarter shows no scores, switching back shows the scores again.
After saving, localStorage['avaliacao.members.v1'] shows the member with periods[<quarter>] populated and NO root scores/plan fields.
The Nine Box and the radar 'Média do time' overlay reflect the currently selected quarter (same quarter for both).
PDI objectives/tasks created under one quarter are not visible under a different quarter, and reappear when switching back.
verification: Open http://localhost:8080, go to Avaliação, set a few scores on the current quarter, use next/prev to change quarter and back; confirm persistence as described.
In DevTools, inspect localStorage['avaliacao.members.v1'] and confirm the saved member has periods and no root scores/plan.
Go to Nine Box and Plano and confirm the quarter bar is present and the data shown matches the selected quarter.
Confirm collaborator read-only behavior is unchanged (dots disabled) — can be checked by temporarily reasoning through canEdit() gating since local mode is leader; do not break the gating.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED in index.html, styles.css, and js/app.js (no changes to js/model.js, js/store.js, firebase-config.js, firestore.rules). FEAT-003 (Evolução tab) intentionally NOT built. INDEX.HTML — quarter-bar containers added to the three view-heads: - #view-evaluate head:
placed BEFORE #member-select. - #view-ninebox head:
placed AFTER the existing .hint span. - #view-plan head:
placed BEFORE #plan-member-select. FEAT-003 should add its own quarter bar container id (suggest 'q-sel-evolution') in the Evolução view-head and call renderQuarterBar('q-sel-evolution') from its render fn; setSelectedPeriod already has an else-if branch for v==='evolution' (currently a no-op placeholder) to hook into. STYLES.CSS — new classes reusing theme vars: .quarter-bar (inline-flex pill, var(--surface-2)/var(--border)), .q-nav (28x28 prev/next buttons, chars '‹'/'›'), .q-label (min-width 72px centered YYYY-Qn text). Added .view-head .quarter-bar{margin-left:auto} plus .view-head .quarter-bar ~ .select{margin-left:0} so when the bar precedes the .select the bar is the right-aligned element and the select follows it with the normal 16px gap (no overlap). APP.JS — new state and helpers (names FEAT-003 will reuse): - STATE: `let selectedPeriod = Store.currentPeriodKey();` (near members/selectedId). This is the SINGLE source of truth shared by Avaliação, Nine Box and Plano (and future Evolução). - shiftPeriod(key, delta) -> 'YYYY-Qn': adds/subtracts quarters with year rollover. Signature exactly as spec. - setSelectedPeriod(key): sets selectedPeriod then re-renders the ACTIVE view only (evaluate/ninebox/plan; evolution branch is a placeholder for FEAT-003). Reads active view via $('.nav-item.active')?.dataset.view. - renderQuarterBar(containerId): clears the container and renders [prev '‹'] [label selectedPeriod] [next '›']; prev/next call setSelectedPeriod(shiftPeriod(selectedPeriod, -1|+1)). Called at the TOP of renderEvaluate (q-sel-evaluate), renderNineBox (q-sel-ninebox), renderPlan (q-sel-plan). - memberPeriod(member, create) -> { scores, plan }: period accessor. create=false returns an EPHEMERAL { scores:{}, plan:[] } without touching member when the period is absent (safe reads); create=true materializes member.periods[selectedPeriod] = { scores:{}, plan:[] } so writes persist. FEAT-003 can read any member's quarter data via member.periods[key] directly or iterate Object.keys(member.periods||{}). PERIOD-AWARE READS/WRITES wired: - renderEvaluate: scoreboard + buildPillarCard avg + drawRadar (memberScoresByCompetency AND teamAverageByCompetency) all pass selectedPeriod; current competency value read from memberPeriod(member,false).scores. The radar 'Média do time' overlay and the Nine Box use the SAME selectedPeriod. - setScore: writes into memberPeriod(member,true).scores (toggles as before), Store.save(member), re-syncs the members[] entry, re-renders. - Plano: renderPlan reads memberPeriod(member,false).plan; addTask/toggleTask/removeTask and the objective-modal save/delete all materialize memberPeriod(member,true) and mutate its .plan. uid()/progress/task logic unchanged. - renderNineBox + renderNineBoxGuide + legend: performanceScore/potentialScore/nineBoxLabel all pass selectedPeriod. - renderTeam card label also passes selectedPeriod (Team view would otherwise show empty data after migration strips root scores, since periodScores(m, undefined) falls back to the now-removed root scores). This keeps the Team view coherent with the global quarter. GATING: canEdit()/Store.isLeader() unchanged — collaborators keep disabled dots/checkboxes even when browsing other quarters. STORE ROUND-TRIP (from FEAT-001, relied upon): LocalStore.save -> prepareForWrite(member,'local') strips root scores/plan and persists periods; so localStorage['avaliacao.members.v1'] holds periods[] and NO root scores/plan after any save. migrateOnRead repopulates periods[currentPeriodKey()] for legacy docs on read. VERIFICATION DONE: caddy served the worktree root on :8080; index.html, js/app.js, js/model.js, styles.css all returned HTTP 200. app.js brace/paren balance confirmed (230/230 braces, 758/758 parens, 26 backticks even). The in-browser click-through (set scores, switch quarters, inspect localStorage) could NOT be executed — no Node/browser automation in this env (only caddy). The data path was validated by code inspection against the already-tested FEAT-001 store: setScore->memberPeriod(create)->Store.save strips root and keeps periods; switching to an empty quarter yields the ephemeral empty read (no scores) and switching back shows the materialized period.
